Load Packages and Data

library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggridges)
#library(scales)
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("nwslR/nwslR", 
                         ref = "v0.0.0.9002")
library(nwslR)
matches <- load_matches()
players <- load_players()
teams <- load_teams()
metrics <- load_metrics()

Exercise 1

portland_matches <- matches %>% 
  filter(home_team_id == 8 | away_team_id == 8)

Exercise 2

home_team_info <- teams %>% 
  select(home_team_id = team_id, 
         home_team_name = team_name, 
         home_team_abbr = team_abbreviation)

portland_matches <- portland_matches %>% 
  left_join(home_team_info)
## Joining with `by = join_by(home_team_id)`
away_team_info <- teams %>% 
  select(away_team_id = team_id, 
         away_team_name = team_name, 
         away_team_abbr = team_abbreviation)

portland_matches <- portland_matches %>% 
  left_join(away_team_info)
## Joining with `by = join_by(away_team_id)`

Exercise 3

portland_matches <- portland_matches %>% 
  mutate(POR_points = if_else(home_team_abbr == "POR", 
                              home_team_score, away_team_score),
      OPP_points = if_else(home_team_abbr == "POR", 
                            away_team_score, home_team_score),
      result = case_when(POR_points  >  OPP_points ~ "Win",
                         POR_points < OPP_points ~ "Loss",
                         POR_points == OPP_points ~ "Tie"))

Exercise 4

ggplot(portland_matches, aes(x = result)) +
  geom_bar()

Exercise 5

ggplot(portland_matches, aes(x = result)) +
  facet_wrap(~season) +
  geom_bar()

Exercise 6

portland_matches <- portland_matches %>% 
  mutate(POR_home_away = if_else(home_team_abbr == "POR", 
                             "home", "away"))

ggplot(portland_matches, aes(y = POR_points, x = POR_home_away)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplot(portland_matches, aes(x = POR_points, y = POR_home_away)) +
  geom_density_ridges()
## Picking joint bandwidth of 0.443

Exercise 7

portland_matches %>% 
  group_by(POR_home_away) %>% 
  summarize(wins = sum(result == "Win"),
                n = n()) %>% 
  mutate(win_perc = wins/n) %>% 
  kable(format = "html", table.attr = "style='width:50%;'") %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_styling()
POR_home_away wins n win_perc

home 63 113 0.5575221

Exericse 8

# * A small number of matches do not have data, so we wrap this in a safe call to ensure this runs without error 
safe_load_pms <- purrr::possibly(load_player_match_stats, otherwise = data.frame())

player_stats <- purrr::map_df(portland_matches$match_id, safe_load_pms, .progress = TRUE)
#saveRDS(player_stats, "./labs/data/player_stats.rds")
player_stats <- readRDS("./data/player_stats.rds")
summary_data <- player_stats %>% 
  filter(team_id == 8) %>% 
  select(player_id, team_id, shots_total, shots_outside_box, goals) %>% 
  group_by(player_id) %>% 
  summarize(shots_total = sum(shots_total),
            shots_outside_box = sum(shots_outside_box, na.rm = TRUE),
            goals = sum(goals, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(shots_total >= 15) %>% 
  mutate(prop_outside_box = shots_outside_box/shots_total,
         prop_goals = goals/shots_total) 

summary_data %>% 
  arrange(desc(prop_outside_box)) %>% 
  left_join(players) %>% 
  slice(1:10) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = prop_outside_box, 
             y = reorder(player_match_name, prop_outside_box))) +
  geom_col(fill = "purple") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Percentage of shots taken outside the box",
       y = "",
       title = "Portland players with Highest % of shots taken outside the box",
       subtitle = "Minimum 15 shots")
## Joining with `by = join_by(player_id)`

summary_data %>% 
  arrange(desc(prop_goals)) %>% 
  left_join(players) %>% 
  slice(1:10) %>% 
  select(player_match_name, shots_total, goals, prop_goals) %>% 
  kable(format = "html", table.attr = "style='width:50%;'") %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_styling()
## Joining with `by = join_by(player_id)`
